subject: Literature
title: Aboriginal Dreamtime Narratives
description: A micro-lesson that makes Aboriginal Dreamtime Narratives usable.

hook.text: Australian Aboriginal Dreamtime is the oldest continuous storytelling tradition on Earth, over sixty thousand years old.

buildup.text: Dreamtime stories describe ancestral beings who sang the world into existence as they walked across the land.

discovery.text: These stories encode precise geographical and ecological knowledge passed orally for thousands of generations.

twist.text: Some Dreamtime stories describe events geologists confirm happened over ten thousand years ago, like rising seas.

climax.text: Dreamtime proves that oral literature can preserve knowledge with astonishing accuracy across vast timescales.

punchline.text: Stories remembered sea levels from ten thousand years ago.

quiz.question: What remarkable accuracy do Dreamtime stories demonstrate?
options: They describe geological events confirmed to have happened over ten thousand years ago
They accurately list every animal species in Australia
